episodes.title: Hell Week, Part 1
episodes.summary: At Belgrave University, Jack pledges a secret society steeped in mystery and magic. Soon, a series of strange murders sets the campus on edge.

episodes.title: Hell Week, Part 2
episodes.summary: Pops shares a theory about the attacks. Jack and Alyssa try to keep an eye on the other pledges. At the Temple, Jack encounters a notorious figure.

episodes.title: Introduction to Ethics, Part 1
episodes.summary: Jack learns he's been selected for a rival secret society. Later, he gets a lesson in magic -- and discovers that every spell has a price.

episodes.title: Introduction to Ethics, Part 2
episodes.summary: Jack proposes an alliance with the Knights, and Randall teaches him how to harness his powers. Meanwhile, Edward takes Alyssa under his wing.

episodes.title: Homecoming, Part 1
episodes.summary: As the Order prepares to conduct a dangerous, sinister spell, the Knights enlist Jack to sabotage their plans.

episodes.title: Homecoming, Part 2
episodes.summary: While the Order hunts for werewolves on campus, Jack and Alyssa flee with Renee's necrophone, a tool used to communicate with the dead.

episodes.title: Undeclared, Part 1
episodes.summary: Alyssa confronts Jack about his secret. Headmistress Vera questions Edward about the Vade Maecum and sends Gabrielle on a truth-seeking mission.

episodes.title: Undeclared, Part 2
episodes.summary: Alyssa helps the Knights search for Randall and stumbles upon a doctor's twisted experiment. Edward is visited by the Vade Maecum's previous owner.

episodes.title: Finals, Part 1
episodes.summary: Consumed by ambition, Edward clashes with Vera -- and Alyssa is caught in the middle. Jack's brush with the Vade Maecum ignites a painful ordeal.

episodes.title: Finals, Part 2
episodes.summary: The Knights plot to thwart Edward's plan by kidnapping his son. Gabrielle and the Hermetic Counselor interrogate Lilith.

episodes.title: Free Radicals, Part 1
episodes.summary: After having the Knights' memories wiped, Vera plans to induct them into the Order, but her new pledges prove hard to control.

episodes.title: Free Radicals, Part 2
episodes.summary: While the Knights look for ways to protect themselves, Alyssa gives Jack a job: find the "magic tourist" whose been wreaking havoc on campus.

episodes.title: Fear Itself, Part 1
episodes.summary: The Knights raid the Order's magic vault, Alyssa confides in Randall about her fading powers, and romance blooms between Lillith and Nicole.

episodes.title: Fear Itself, Part 2
episodes.summary: Vera leads the Order in a spell to summon Rogwan, a powerful demon. But when her plan goes awry, she needs the Knights on her side.

episodes.title: The Commons, Part 1
episodes.summary: Vera negotiates a deal with the Sons of Prometheus - a rival magic society - and sends Jack and Alyssa to their compound as hostages.

episodes.title: The Commons, Part 2
episodes.summary: Amid a standoff with the Prometheans, Alyssa goes into withdrawal. Meanwhile, Randall, Hamish and Gabrielle track professor Foley.

episodes.title: Spring Outbreak, Part 1
episodes.summary: The Knights weigh whether to join the Order. Alyssa suspects that her feelings for Jack might be blocking her magic. Kepler pulls rank on Vera.

episodes.title: Spring Outbreak, Part 2
episodes.summary: The Knights try to prevent a strange affliction from spreading. Kepler schemes to strip Vera of her power, and Alyssa searches Vera's house.

episodes.title: New World Order, Part 1
episodes.summary: Nicole finds a spell that could bring back Lilith, but it hinges on Alyssa's cooperation. Jack tries to broker a deal between Vera and Salvador.

episodes.title: New World Order, Part 2
episodes.summary: As chaos reigns, the Knights must convince Vera and Alyssa to work together to seal the eruption and save Lilith from the demon realm.
